purpose: Collects several open-ended values, such as emails or labels, turning each entry into a removable chip inline in the field or stacked outside it.

notFor.case: Values chosen from a known list.

Default.visual: Surface/input box with a Border/control edge; typed text in Content/primary, placeholder in Content/subtle.

Focused.visual: Border/focus edge with a Border/ring/default halo.

Invalid.visual: Status/critical/border-strong edge with a Status/critical/border halo.

Disabled.visual: Action/disabled/default fill; placeholder in Content/disabled; chips go Disabled.

Loading.meaning: Work on the values is running (aria-busy).
Loading.visual: The Default look with a spinner.

Value=filled.visual: InputTagChips; tags past max are drawn critical.

a11y.role: textbox (native text input); chips are removable tags with their own remove buttons
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the text input; each chip's remove button is its own tab stop. Enter or comma commits the draft as a tag; Backspace on an empty draft takes the last tag back.
notes: Keep a visible label (Field) and expose the error through aria-describedby.
Clicking anywhere in the box focuses the text input.

openQuestions: Announcements: the contract says added and removed tags must be announced, but names no live region. Who announces them, and with what words?
Reduced motion: should the edge and halo transitions (use-hover, use-focus) be instant with reduced motion?
Over max: tags past max are drawn critical. Is the field also Invalid then, or only the extra chips?
